# Python v0.0.2 Oracle

This directory freezes the externally observable compatibility baseline from
`oceanbase/powercontext` commit
`3a6cb0151670eaff7dc0293466edd673124e80da`.

The database, scheduler, domain, provider, and Handoff Report fixtures are
generated by the scripts in `test/conformance`; `manifest.json` records their
hashes together with the exact OpenAPI, prompt, and Python test inventories.
The directory is immutable after review. A new Python baseline must use a new
versioned directory rather than rewriting this one silently.
